lines.text: Editor: exports and the 100 % view lose the purple and green fringes near the frame's edges. Export again to fix one.
Exports use the phone's CPU beside its GPU, so they finish sooner; smaller ones are sharper, with less moiré.
Zoomed out, photos are now built from a full demosaic: crisper, with less false colour on fine lines.
The Library loads faster, the dial stays put, Auto level holds, and before and after show your crop.
